أَبِدٌ Unsocial, unsociable, unfamiliar, or shy; like a wild animal; applied to a man, and to a young camel: (S, L:) and ↓ إِبِدٌ , applied to a female slave, and to a she-ass, signifies shunning mankind, shy, or wild. (K.) [See also آبِدٌ.] ＝
-A2- See also إِبِدٌ, in four places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
